history.summary: Older 99LH D12 development priced well below district median PSF, but the headline 14.3% URA appreciation rests on just 5 transactions and is not trustworthy. The 1399sqft 'cheap-PSF' 3BR is an oversized unit, so the $1,036 PSF flatters the absolute $1.45M ticket more than it signals value.
history.rating_rationale: $1,036 PSF vs $1,057 URA median is roughly fair, not a bargain once you account for the large 1399sqft floorplate inflating absolute price. The 14.3%/yr appreciation is statistically meaningless at only 5 txns. A 2003-built leasehold (~76yrs left) in Toa Payoh fringe with no listed MRT and no near catalyst — decent liquidity from D12 demand but no clear upside thesis.
red_flags: Appreciation rate from only 5 URA transactions — unreliable
Oversized 1399sqft 3BR inflates absolute price; PSF looks cheap but ticket is not
No MRT listed within walking distance
catalysts: Sub-$1.5M entry keeps buyer pool reasonably deep
